name: Apache Software Foundation Security
description: Manages security for 300+ open source projects. ASF is a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) assigning CVE IDs to vulnerabilities in Apache software. All code changes go through peer review.

peerReview.processDescription: ASF is a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA). Private disclosure, Review by project committers and security team, Apache Security Advisory publication. All code changes go through peer review via pull requests/JIRA. PMC oversight for security decisions.

attribution.attributionNotes: Apache security advisories globally recognized. ASF commit access is a professional credential. CVE credits for Apache vulnerabilities are highly respected.

povsAlignment.description: Code repository contribution through CNA role and maintainer-based peer review.
